title: Populate bike catalog with Yamaha R15, KTM Duke 390, and Royal Enfield Classic 350 data

requirements.summary: Display engine capacity and mileage fields in catalog cards and detail page for each bike
acceptanceCriteria: Each bike card on the catalog page shows the engine and mileage values.
The bike detail page also displays engine and mileage in the specs section.
Values match what is stored in the backend (e.g., ₹1,80,000, 155cc, 40 km/l for Yamaha R15).

file_operations.description: Add engine and mileage display below the price in each bike card, reading from the bike.engine and bike.mileage properties fetched from the backend.
Add engine and mileage rows in the specifications section of the bike detail page, displaying the values from bike.engine and bike.mileage properties.

requirements.summary: Display Unsplash image URLs as bike photos in catalog cards and detail page
acceptanceCriteria: BikeCard renders the bike's image URL from backend data as the card photo.
BikeDetailPage renders the same image URL in the photo carousel.
No placeholder image is shown when a valid image URL is present.

file_operations.description: Update the image rendering logic to use bike.photos[0] from the backend as the card image source instead of category-based placeholder images when a valid photo URL is present.

Update the carousel to render bike.photos array from the backend as the image sources, ensuring the Unsplash URLs (e.g., https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1609630875171-b1321377ee65 for Yamaha R15) are displayed in the photo carousel.
